impact:
T-021 states that a T-016 NO-GO kills notarization and therefore the Homebrew cask, but its acceptance criterion 4 unconditionally requires shipping a cask whose quarantined artifact passes Gatekeeper. T-016 NO-GO is an explicitly allowed outcome of that gate, so one valid upstream result makes T-021 impossible to complete as written — the ticket can only be closed by ignoring its own criterion.

Suggested fix: make criterion 4 conditional on the T-016 outcome. On GO, ship and verify the notarized cask; on NO-GO, either remove cask from scope explicitly or define an approved npm-wrapping formula outcome and validate that instead.

Found by codex review during T-008 round 14. Same class as ISS-035 (T-014 soft gate / T-022 scope contradiction): acceptance criteria that contradict the ticket's own stated conditions.
title: T-021 is unsatisfiable when T-016 returns an allowed NO-GO: its cask criterion is unconditional
